a.name: ChatGPT based on the GPT 3.5 base model, accessed through a custom API
a.locator: PDF p. 10, Method, Story Writing Task

b.name: ChatGPT based on the GPT 3.5 base model, accessed through a custom API
b.locator: PDF p. 10, Method, Story Writing Task: "A custom API was used to call ChatGPT based on the GPT 3.5 base model." No model release year or exact API snapshot is stated.

a.name: AI-help
a.description: Story written with free access to a ChatGPT side textbox. A hidden system prompt limited output to bullet-point ideas and prevented entire story passages; copy-paste was disabled (PDF p. 10, Story Writing Task; Appendix A, PDF p. 32). Each analyzed participant completed this condition.

a.name: No-AI
a.description: Story written in the matched interface with the ChatGPT textbox removed (PDF p. 10, Story Writing Task; Appendix B, PDF p. 32). Participants were instructed to use the suggested prompting strategies as self-directed brainstorming (PDF p. 11). Each analyzed participant completed this condition.

b.name: AI-help
b.description: Each participant wrote a story with free access to ChatGPT in a side textbox. A hidden system prompt restricted responses to bullet-point ideas and prevented entire story passages; copy-paste was disabled. PDF p. 10, Story Writing Task; Appendix A, PDF p. 32.

b.name: No-AI
b.description: The same participants wrote a story in a matched interface without the ChatGPT textbox. Before both conditions, all completed a practice story with ChatGPT available; actual practice use by every participant is not established. PDF pp. 10-11, Story Writing Task; Appendix B, PDF p. 32.
